description_en: Calls DescribeBackups to obtain the backup list of a cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeBackups获取集群备份列表
kebab_example: aliyun cassandra describe-backups --cluster-id cds-uf6m0bod00006158 --data-center-id cn-shanghai-e --backup-type Incremental --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data center in the backup cluster
parameters.name: data_center_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

full: full backup
Incremental: incremental backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。取值：

full：全量备份
Incremental：增量备份
parameters.name: backup_type
